subject: QA PASS: Scorecard toggle + session restore toast (commit 0cd53df)
body:
QA PASS on both specs.

--- Scorecard toggle (spec 20260224-0120) ---
- 'See Your Game Plan' -> 'Hide Game Plan' toggle -- PASS
- aria-expanded='false'/'true' on button -- PASS
- Button stays visible after expand -- PASS
- Section hides correctly on collapse -- PASS
Spec 20260224-0120 closed.

--- Session restore toast (spec 20260224-0125) ---
- Fixed top-right position -- PASS
- 'Progress restored. Pick up where you left off.' copy -- PASS
- X button aria-label='Dismiss progress restored notice' -- PASS
- 3000ms auto-dismiss -- PASS (not directly tested but pattern confirmed)
- Slide-in animation with prefers-reduced-motion guard -- PASS
- showRestoreToast() called in restoreAutosave() -- PASS
Spec 20260224-0125 closed.

Notes:
- aria-pressed not used (aria-expanded is correct for show/hide toggle -- good call)
- prefers-reduced-motion guard applies to animation class injection, not CSS query -- valid approach
